facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1939 and recorded as gone.

notes_for_editor: Both pages are hobby-site entries (firelookout.com by Rex Kamstra; the Idaho site appears to repeat that material), so this is one line of evidence, not two. No Forest Service, NRHP or register record was found. The record's elevation_m is null while both pages give 5,744 ft (about 1,751 m); not added as a correction. The record's kind 'ground' is not contradicted, but the sources only say 'log cabin with ladder to access', so it is unclear whether the cabin sat on the ground. A search returned 'Doe Point' (camp 1939, about 10 miles NW of Moose Creek Ranger Station), a different site; it is not used here. Nothing in the sources describes the site today.
